title: 有限声明路线的行动力与基础战斗收益比较
remaining_item: P3探索路线收益评价；只关闭明确方案的移动/基础战斗分项连贯比较
new_capability: 共同声明图和库存下并列核算1–20条路线，付款/次数/首次返还独立账本；未知或受阻尾链、重复战斗不虚增奖励，同终点只按闭合净AP/基础经验/源石锭区间保守比较；实际最优和完整收益未知。真实局外工具中文表/四预设/显式地图链接接入且刷新不覆盖工作。
source_evidence: 既有exploration-reference/node-arrival原件及步骤规则，第220节首次到达来源保持；未改移动公式。
第223节PRTS433770完整基础结算表/a550关卡身份，source reconstruction230保留原documented_floors；不新增服务器机制假设。
acceptance: 新14 API+5实际临时Qt：区间端点、AP返还、尾链、重复奖励、未知/失败、非法数据、输入隔离、四预设、状态保留及过期地图链接。
原10+结算+新增路线12查询和所有既有七边界/六羽瞰点/七基础奖励预设全部保留执行，不缩减测试。
limitations: Finite supplied plans and explicitly listed battle components only; no route enumeration/probability/success or server eligibility inferred.
Conditional dominance ignores unverified event rewards, failures, ending prerequisites, dynamic residents, difficulty reward modifiers and complete pools; it is never actual optimal route.
Repeated reward eligibility and zero-AP callback order remain unknown; independent tail documentation is not admitted to known totals.
Temporary Qt checks, not game or original visible-window verification; original0.90 remains available and new query checked at grouped window update.
preparation_failures: Public draft initially used invalid raw BATTLE instead of BATTLE_NORMAL; corrected fixture, exact type guard unchanged.
Imported-node Qt fixture initially lacked zone_id, so existing link guard properly rejected it; source declaration now complete without weakening guard.
ops_maintenance: Finisher now always stages cloud selector registration after a full-gate preflight, preventing earlier generated registrations from being left only local. Existing map051 union preserved.
